tools.name: flespi_get_token_info
tools.description: Show the flespi token this server uses: its id, customer id, enabled and blocked state, expiry, and access rules. Good first call to check the connection. flespi API: GET /auth/info.

tools.name: flespi_list_devices
tools.description: List devices (trackers and other connected units) with their id, name, protocol, telemetry and configuration. Use selector "all" or a filter such as "protocol_name=teltonika". flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_get_device_telemetry
tools.description: Read the latest telemetry values of devices, such as position, speed, fuel or ignition. telemetry_selector "all" returns every parameter. flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}/telemetry/{telemetry_selector}.

tools.name: flespi_list_device_messages
tools.description: Read the most recent stored messages of devices, optionally between two UNIX timestamps and limited to some fields. flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}/messages with the data filter.

tools.name: flespi_list_channels
tools.description: List channels (data-ingestion endpoints that devices connect to) with their id, name, protocol and status. flespi API: GET /gw/channels/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_list_geofences
tools.description: List geofences (geographic zones) with their id, name and shape. flespi API: GET /gw/geofences/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_list_groups
tools.description: List device groups used to organize devices and assign them in bulk. flespi API: GET /gw/groups/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_list_calcs
tools.description: List calculators (rules that turn device messages into intervals and reports) with their configuration. flespi API: GET /gw/calcs/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_list_streams
tools.description: List streams (outgoing data flows that forward device data to other systems) with their id, name and protocol. flespi API: GET /gw/streams/{selector}.

tools.name: flespi_create_device
tools.description: Create one or more devices. Each object must include device_type_id and configuration, for example {"name":"Van 4","device_type_id":1,"configuration":{"ident":"<IMEI>"}}. Creates new records; it does not change existing devices. flespi API: POST /gw/devices.

tools.name: flespi_update_device
tools.description: Change the properties of the devices matched by selector, for example {"name":"Van 4 (depot)"}. Only the given fields change. flespi API: PUT /gw/devices/{selector}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: flespi_list_device_messages, flespi_list_calcs · Private data: flespi_get_token_info, flespi_create_device · Public sink: flespi_list_streams, flespi_create_device.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: flespi_list_device_messages, flespi_list_calcs · Private data: flespi_get_token_info, flespi_create_device · Public sink: flespi_list_streams, flespi_create_device

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
